entries.description: Countersigned the orchestrator-drafted E5-quater slots WITH an amendment: the route's constructor checklist (sums, products, composition, exp, log, division) describes a different inductive type. EMLTree is const|var|eml with no division constructor. Walking that checklist would have burned session 1 discovering the type. Caught by checking the source before ratifying — which is what makes a countersignature worth more than a rubber stamp.
